snippet.title: FingerLaserX - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Your fingers are the weapon. Swipe to fire, defend your base, and take down bosses.
Pre-register now: https://fl-x.cc/f/yt
Worldwide launch: October 20, 2026, on iOS and Android.

FingerLaserX is an offline neon arcade shooter, rebuilt from the ground up by the one guy who made the original FingerLaser in 2012.

No forced ads. No energy meter. No account. No Wi-Fi needed.

#FingerLaserX #arcadegame #shooter
